title: HelperSessionSnapshotResult
description: One consistent read of a session's screen (nocx-6q1uh.5, spec §6.1): the frame a coordinator classifies with the agent rule, the runtime facts session.screen already answers, and the access-epoch and read-barrier facts a target minted from THIS snapshot inherits. Every field describes the same instant — the fence is read before the screen, never after (spec §5.4).

snapshotId.description: Names this reading within the session's retained ring (a ring of 8, each held at most 2s). session.target mints against it; an evicted or aged-out id is refused snapshot_gone.

revision.description: The runtime's monotonic clock at the read — the same fact session.screen already reports.

readBarrier.description: Whether this session's read side currently guarantees nothing written before this snapshot is still unobserved. True for a local PTY's raw, drained read; a session with none (an SSH channel with no barrier of its own, nocx-6q1uh.3) reports false.
